text: Caught in a whirlpool. <break time="0.8s" /> He was spun around. <break time="0.8s" /> Until he was thrown onto a gravel bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Far out of the soldiers sight. <break time="0.8s" /> He dug his fingers into the sand. <break time="0.8s" /> And wept with joy. <break time="0.8s" /> And the trees around him. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked as beautiful as a garden. <break time="0.8s" /> When a cannonball crashed. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the branches above his head. <break time="0.8s" /> He jumped up. <break time="0.8s" /> And rushed into the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> All that day he walked on guided by the sun. <break time="0.8s" /> But the forest seemed to have no end. <break time="0.8s" /> By nightfall. <break time="0.8s" /> He was tired, hungry, and footsore. <break time="0.8s" /> But the thought of his wife and children. <break time="0.8s" /> Kept him moving. <break time="0.8s" /> At last he found. <break time="0.8s" /> A wide, straight road. <break time="0.8s" /> Leading toward home. <break time="0.8s" /> But strangely there were no fields or houses. <break time="0.8s" /> Along it. <break time="0.8s" /> Nowhere could he hear. <break time="0.8s" /> Even the barking of a dog. <break time="0.8s" /> And the black trees stood on both sides. <break time="0.8s" /> Like high walls. <break time="0.8s" /> Above him. <break time="0.8s" /> The stars looked strange. <break time="0.8s" /> Shining in groups he had never seen. <break time="0.8s" /> And he heard whispers. <break time="0.8s" /> In an unknown language. <break time="0.8s" /> His neck was badly swollen. <break time="0.8s" /> His tongue was dry with thirst. <break time="0.8s" /> And at last he fell asleep. <break time="0.8s" /> While still walking.
